source_note: 复三角多项式在Lp空间中的稠密性
english_source_note: Density of Complex Trigonometric Polynomials in Lp

statement_en: The set of all complex trigonometric polynomials is dense in $L^p([a,b]\to \mathbb{C})$ for $1\leq p<\infty$.
key_techniques: density of trigonometric polynomials in continuous periodic functions
prerequisites: uniform norm and $L^p$ norm comparison on bounded intervals
